posts.name: Nitish
posts.cooked: I scored only 30/100 in OPPE1. Will I have to repeat OPPE in another term or would i get a final grade if i score above 40 in OPPE2

posts.name: Kunal Gupta
posts.cooked: Yes, if you pass any one of the OPPEs, you will receive your final marks and pass the Python course.
